description: This file defines the ServiceException class, a custom exception used within the application to handle service layer errors. It extends the standard Java Exception class, adding features such as exception type categorization and message codes.

classes.name: ServiceException
classes.description: Custom exception class used for errors generated by application services, with additional properties for exception type and message code.

methods.name: setMessageCode
methods.description: Sets the message code associated with the exception.

methods.name: getMessageCode
methods.description: Retrieves the message code associated with the exception.

methods.name: getExceptionType
methods.description: Returns the integer representing the type of exception.

methods.name: ServiceException
methods.description: Multiple constructors allowing creation of ServiceException with different details (message, cause, type, message code).
